scenes.tts: Does a cell simply measure how much Sonic hedgehog it sees? Or does time matter too?
scenes.visual: Title card: Level and Time. A gold dial beside a clock.
scenes.narration: Does a cell simply measure how much Sonic hedgehog it sees? Or does time matter too?

scenes.tts: Concentration turned out to be only half of the reading. Part of the other half lies in the brake.
scenes.visual: A dial labelled level, with a second empty dial beside it labelled ?
scenes.narration: Concentration turned out to be only half of the reading. Part of the other half lies in the brake.

scenes.tts: Recall the brake. Patched holds the pathway off, and Sonic hedgehog lifts it.
scenes.visual: Patched and Smoothened drawn apart in the membrane, joined by a blunt inhibition arrow from Patched to Smoothened. Small label: an analogy, not physical contact. Shh binds Patched and the inhibition arrow fades.
scenes.narration: Recall the brake. Patched holds the pathway off, and Sonic hedgehog lifts it.

scenes.tts: Here is the twist. Patched one is also one of the genes Sonic hedgehog turns on.
scenes.caption: Here is the twist. Patched1 is also one of the genes Sonic hedgehog turns on.
scenes.visual: An arrow loops from the nucleus back to the membrane: more Patched1 is made.
scenes.narration: Here is the twist. Patched1 is also one of the genes Sonic hedgehog turns on.

scenes.tts: That sounds backwards. More receptor should mean more sensitivity. But Patched is a brake.
scenes.visual: Two captions: more receptor, more sensitive? Then: Patched is a brake.
scenes.narration: That sounds backwards. More receptor should mean more sensitivity. But Patched is a brake.

scenes.tts: In chick neural cells, signaling builds part of its own brake. Then it takes more signal to keep going.
scenes.visual: More brake symbols appear on the membrane as the signal continues, then level off. Label: one contributor to adaptation.
scenes.narration: In chick neural cells, signaling builds part of its own brake. Then it takes more signal to keep going.

scenes.tts: Picture two cells starting at once. One gets a low dose of Sonic hedgehog. The other gets a high dose.
scenes.visual: Two cells side by side, one faint gold, one bright gold. Each has a Gli activity trace beginning below it.
scenes.narration: Picture two cells starting at once. One gets a low dose of Sonic hedgehog. The other gets a high dose.

scenes.tts: Both make more Patched as they go.
scenes.visual: Patched builds up in both cells.
scenes.narration: Both make more Patched as they go.

scenes.tts: Predict. In which cell does signaling fade first?
scenes.visual: Question on screen: in which cell does signaling fade first?
scenes.narration: Predict. In which cell does signaling fade first?

scenes.tts: The low-dose cell. Its signaling soon fades. The high-dose cell keeps signaling for longer.
scenes.visual: The low-dose trace falls first; the high-dose trace stays up longer.
scenes.narration: The low-dose cell. Its signaling soon fades. The high-dose cell keeps signaling for longer.

scenes.tts: In two thousand seven, Eric Dessaud, James Briscoe and colleagues reported this in chick neural cells.
scenes.caption: In 2007, Eric Dessaud, James Briscoe and colleagues reported this in chick neural cells.
scenes.visual: Credit card: Dessaud, Briscoe and colleagues, 2007.
scenes.narration: In 2007, Eric Dessaud, James Briscoe and colleagues reported this in chick neural cells.

scenes.tts: The cells adapt. Signaling inside them fades, partly through rising Patched one.
scenes.caption: The cells adapt. Signaling inside them fades, partly through rising Patched1.
scenes.visual: Label: adaptation. The traces fade as Patched1 rises.
scenes.narration: The cells adapt. Signaling inside them fades, partly through rising Patched1.

scenes.tts: Higher concentrations kept signaling going longer. A level becomes a length of time.
scenes.visual: A dial turns into a bar of time. Label: level becomes duration.
scenes.narration: Higher concentrations kept signaling going longer. A level becomes a length of time.

scenes.tts: Now test it. Hold the dose fixed, and change only how long the cells are exposed. What should longer exposure do?
scenes.visual: A row of explants at one dose, each with a clock showing a different exposure time. Question on screen.
scenes.narration: Now test it. Hold the dose fixed, and change only how long the cells are exposed. What should longer exposure do?

scenes.tts: In two thousand ten, the same laboratory did this in chick explants.
scenes.caption: In 2010, the same laboratory did this in chick explants.
scenes.visual: Credit: Dessaud, Sasai, Briscoe and colleagues, 2010.
scenes.narration: In 2010, the same laboratory did this in chick explants.

scenes.tts: At a fixed dose, longer exposure gave progressively more ventral identities.
scenes.visual: The transverse neural tube map, dorsal up: notochord below, floor plate at the bottom, ventricular zone around the central canal, roof plate at the top, epidermis over it. Explants with longer clocks take identities from stripes lower and lower in the wall.
scenes.narration: At a fixed dose, longer exposure gave progressively more ventral identities.

scenes.tts: The time a cell spends signaling is part of its address.
scenes.visual: The address label from chapter 3 gains a second line: time.
scenes.narration: The time a cell spends signaling is part of its address.

scenes.tts: Roughly, a cell's identity tracks how much signaling it has had so far.
scenes.visual: Two traces under one cell: a history trace of past signaling that builds as signaling goes on, and a separate trace of ventral marker expression.
scenes.narration: Roughly, a cell's identity tracks how much signaling it has had so far.

scenes.tts: It also needs the signal to continue for a while to keep that identity.
scenes.visual: The signal is switched off. Pathway activity falls; some time later the marker trace can fall too. Label: history is a record of past signaling, not a stored total.
scenes.narration: It also needs the signal to continue for a while to keep that identity.

scenes.tts: In chick explants, cutting the signal off with cyclopamine made cells fall back to more dorsal fates.
scenes.visual: Cyclopamine is added to an explant; its pathway activity drops, and later fewer motor neurons and more dorsal neurons appear.
scenes.narration: In chick explants, cutting the signal off with cyclopamine made cells fall back to more dorsal fates.

scenes.tts: Duration carries information in many signaling pathways. Here, it helps set which positional identity a progenitor adopts.
scenes.visual: Several pathway icons, each with a clock beside it. Then back to the neural tube map.
scenes.narration: Duration carries information in many signaling pathways. Here, it helps set which positional identity a progenitor adopts.

scenes.tts: The simulation in this lesson lets you set both the level and the time, and watch the domain change.
scenes.visual: A sketch of the lesson simulation: a level slider, a time slider, and a domain read-out.
scenes.narration: The simulation in this lesson lets you set both the level and the time, and watch the domain change.

scenes.tts: The takeaway: a progenitor reads both how much signal it gets, and for how long.
scenes.visual: Takeaway card: level and time. The dial and the clock side by side.
scenes.narration: The takeaway: a progenitor reads both how much signal it gets, and for how long.
